buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Commandant 92 Base Hospital Badami Bagh Conttotment Srinagar PIN-190004 . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of Commandant 92 Base Hospital payable at Commandant 92 Base Hospital . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 6. The service provider shall carry out repair and maintenance of office furniture and chairs at the buyer's pre mises as per the requirement of the department. 7. The service provider shall inspect the furniture and chairs before commencement of the repair work and as sess the repair requirements. 8. The service provider shall provide skilled manpower, necessary tools, equipment and materials required fo r satisfactory completion of the repair work. 9. The repair work shall include, but not be limited to, the following: Repair of office chairs, revolving chairs and wooden chairs. Repair of damaged chair frames, armrests, backrests and seat mechanisms. Replacement of damaged chair wheels, hydraulic systems, gas lifts, screws, nuts and bolts. Repair of office tables, desks, drawers, hinges, locks and handles. Repair of wooden and steel furniture, including damaged joints, legs and supporting structures. Repair of other furniture items as required by the buyer. 10. All replacement parts and materials shall be new, unused and of suitable quality. 11. The service provider shall submit an item-wise estimate for repair and replacement of parts, wherever req uired, for approval of the buyer before commencement of the work.

12. No additional repair or replacement work shall be carried out without prior approval of the competent auth ority. 13. The service provider shall complete the repair work within the stipulated period as specified in the work or der. 14. The service provider shall ensure that all repaired furniture and chairs are restored to satisfactory working condition. 15. The service provider shall be responsible for any damage caused to the furniture or other property due to negligence during the repair work. Such damage shall be rectified at the service provider's own cost. 16. A minimum warranty of 03 months shall be provided on repaired parts and workmanship from the date of completion of the repair work. 17. Any defect arising due to defective workmanship or replacement parts during the warranty period shall be rectified by the service provider without any additional cost to the buyer. 18. The repaired furniture and chairs shall be inspected by the buyer or authorized representative before acce ptance of the work. 19. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory completion of the repair work and certification by the author ized representative, as per applicable GeM contract terms. 20. The service provider shall comply with all applicable safety instructions and statutory requirements while c arrying out the repair work. 21. The buyer reserves the right to reject unsatisfactory repair work and direct the service provider to rectify t he defects without any additional cost. 22. The service provider shall not subcontract the repair work without prior approval of the buyer, wherever su ch approval is required under the applicable contract conditions. 23. The buyer reserves the right to cancel the work order in case of failure of the service provider to perform t he work satisfactorily, subject to applicable GeM contract terms. .
